parent_objective: design source-heldout residual calibration using M814 adaptive primary corpus
blocked_by: need calibration design with source-heldout and retention gates

public_gates: M816 must preserve the P0 human-view actor contract
M816 must keep actor and residual-head base weights frozen in the design unless a separate calibrator is explicitly proposed
M816 must define source-heldout split and old-gate retention before implementation
M816 must keep PPO and promotion blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not train actor or residual parameters
do not add oracle deploy-time inputs
do not widen the primary 0.00005 margin threshold
do not tune from private holdout failures
do not claim true wheel-level faults from current proxy data

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_distribution: residual calibration design from adaptive primary corpus
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs the first calibration route allowed by the M814 source/axis-diverse primary corpus pass
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no calibrator implementation PPO or driver promotion
stop_condition: stop if design lacks source-heldout split
stop if design lacks old replay or behavior retention gates
stop if design updates actor weights
stop if design treats M814 corpus pass as promotion evidence
fallback_plan: if calibration design is too weak, design holdout/generalization audit first
if intervention sensitivity cannot be represented, return to corpus diagnostics
if simulator limits dominate, route to simulator-fidelity planning
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M816 follows M815 audit after adaptive bracketing corpus pass

hypothesis: A residual calibration design can use the M814 adaptive primary corpus safely if it includes source-heldout split, normal-margin retention, intervention sensitivity retention, and old-gate replay checks.
success_criteria: M816 specifies train and holdout split rules
M816 specifies calibration objective and exact gates
M816 specifies old-gate and behavior retention checks
M816 preserves no-PPO and no-promotion invariants
M816 names the implementation blocker explicitly
failure_criteria: M816 starts PPO or promotes a checkpoint
M816 weakens the primary margin threshold
decision_rule: M816 may only design the residual calibration route. It must not run calibration, PPO, or promotion.
